client.industry_secondary: Outpatient addiction treatment (opioid & alcohol use disorders)
client.client_history: Founded in 2010, SaVida Health provides medication-assisted treatment for opioid and alcohol use disorders. The company was acquired by healthcare-focused private equity firm Council Capital in 2017 and has since expanded to operate more than 20 clinics across several U.S. states.

revenue.notes: Only indicative estimates available from LeadIQ; no official or corroborating figures found. Range too broad to state a single reliable number, so revenue left null.

locations.source: Behavioral Health Business article 21-Oct-2020 stating 'more than 20 outpatient centers' (bhbusiness.com/pipeline-savidas-continued-expansion…)
locations.notes: Company website and other news releases reference 'over 20' clinics but do not list a precise count. Using the conservative minimum of 20.

employees.source: LeadIQ employee directory (Oct 2025) reporting ~165 employees; SignalHire and Clodura list 100-200 and 155 respectively.
employees.notes: Multiple third-party sources cluster between 155-165 employees; LeadIQ provides the most specific recent figure.
